evidence: Jetz & Pyron 2018 distribute the maximum-likelihood tree of the sequenced species (vertlife GCS amphibiantree/download/amph_shl_new.tre, 270,362 bytes, the same size as the held copy); it is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv.
McTavish et al. 2025 distribute the tree restricted to phylogeny-placed taxa (AvesData 1.3, phylo_only_clements_labels.tre); it is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv.
Rabosky et al. 2018 distribute the dated tree of the sequenced species (fishtreeoflife.org, actinopt_12k_treePL.tre); it is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv.

Upham et al. 2019 distribute DNA-only node-dated tree sets of the 4,098 sequenced species (vertlife GCS mammaltree/DNAonly_4098sp_topoFree_NDexp.zip and DNAonly_4098sp_topoFree_FBDasZhouEtAl.zip, listed 2026-10-08); the atlas enumerates the same species from the samp=sampled flags (Data/molecular_sources/mammals.taxa.txt). Branch lengths measured on whitebox from the first tree of the DNA-only set (the set is not held on this computer; Data/worked_example_tree_sets.csv).
Smith & Brown 2018 distribute GBMB, the tree of the species with GenBank data and a backbone, beside ALLMB (GitHub release v0.1); it is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv.

Stein et al. 2018 distribute the 610-species tree sets of the sequenced species, dated under each scenario (data.vertlife.org/sharktree); the 10-fossil set (D46) is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv; its 610 tip labels equal those of the 1-fossil set.
Tonini et al. 2016 distribute the maximum-likelihood tree of the 5,415 sequenced squamates plus Sphenodon (Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.db005); it is the molecular source used for Data/molecular_tips.csv.
